flagged.title: Social Challenges in Africa & South Asia
flagged.reason: The video states and displays an incorrect infant mortality rate of 27 per 1,000 for sub-Saharan Africa (which is actually around 48 per 1,000, 27 being near the world average).

mark_affecting.quote: In sub-Saharan Africa, around 27 babies in every 1,000 die before their first birthday
